label: RBv1
reply:
**Claim reference:** RBv1-CLM-15_formats

**Status: Referred to a claims handler.** The claims system returned `status: escalated` with reason `late_report`. No settlement was prepared or staged.

**Facts recorded**
- Policyholder: Claire Martin, policy VER-1001, Peugeot 208 (2021).
- Coverage: C2 (collision damage) is in the Policy Schedule.
- Incident: 02/10/2026, bollard strike while parking. Single vehicle, no third party.
- Reported: 11/10/2026 (email date), 9 days after the incident.
- Repair quote: 650,00 € for the customer's own car.
- Documents recorded as provided: damage_photos.zip and repair_quote.pdf. None are missing. I have not opened either file.
- Exclusion signals: none found.

**Reasoning**
- **Late report:** A claim must be reported within 5 days of the incident (<cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2" name="Veridia contract"/> Article 4.1). This claim was reported 9 days after the incident, so it is late. Under Article 7.1, a claim reported after the Article 4.1 deadline is referred to a claims handler. The customer's reason (work) is not an exception that I can apply. A late claim is never refused automatically (<cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="3" name="Veridia contract"/> Article 7).
- **Coverage:** Collision damage to the policyholder's own car is covered under C2 and is listed in the Policy Schedule (<cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="1" name="Veridia contract"/> Article 2).
- **Exclusions:** None apparent from the email (<cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2" name="Veridia contract"/> Article 3).
- **Documents:** The required items were provided, so no document request was needed (<cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2" name="Veridia contract"/> Article 4.3).
- **Settlement:** Not computed. The open late-report referral blocks settlement, so the system did not run `compute_settlement` or `stage_settlement`.

**Amounts:** Not computed. No deductible, payout or assessor decision has been made. The handler will decide these.

**Actions taken in the claims system**
1. `get_policy` (VER-1001): policy schedule retrieved.
2. `create_claim`: claim opened. The system recorded the late report and the required documents as present.
3. `escalate_to_handler` (late_report): referred to a claims handler.

**Draft message to the customer**

> Dear Ms Martin,
>
> Thank you for your claim regarding the incident on 2 October 2026 (policy VER-1001, reference RBv1-CLM-15_formats). We have received your damage photos and repair quote.
>
> Because the claim was reported after the contractual reporting deadline, it has been referred to a Veridia claims handler, who will review it and contact you. We appreciate your patience.
>
> Kind regards,
> Veridia Claims Team
